
# enviromental permanova

```{r load_data_comparison, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
load("data/data.Rdata")
load("data/beta.Rdata")
load("data/hill.Rdata")
```

```{r Pivot the Hill-long to wide, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

env_hill_df <- hill_long %>%
  rename(sample = id) %>%               
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols      = sample,
    names_from   = q,
    values_from  = value,
    names_prefix = "env_hill_q"
  )

meta <- sample_metadata %>%
  left_join(env_hill_df, by = "sample")
```

```{r PERMANOVAs for q0, q1n, q1f, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
run_permanova <- function(beta_obj, meta) {
  dist_obj <- beta_obj$S
  samples  <- attr(dist_obj, "Labels")
  meta_aligned <- meta %>%
    filter(sample %in% samples) %>%
    arrange(match(sample, samples))
  stopifnot(identical(meta_aligned$sample, samples))

  hill_vars <- c("env_hill_qhill_q0",
                 "env_hill_qhill_q1",
                 "env_hill_qhill_q2")
  for (v in hill_vars) {
    meta_tmp <- meta_aligned[, v, drop = FALSE]
    colnames(meta_tmp) <- "alpha"
    res <- adonis2(dist_obj ~ alpha,
                   data = meta_tmp,
                   permutations = 999)
    cat("\n--- PERMANOVA for", v, "---\n")
    print(res)
  }
}

run_permanova(beta_q0n, meta)
run_permanova(beta_q1n, meta)
run_permanova(beta_q1f, meta)
```

```{r Prepare distance matrices, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Prepare distance matrices
bray_dist0n <- beta_q0n$S
bray_dist1n <- beta_q1n$S
bray_dist1f <- beta_q1f$S
```


```{r Helper to make each plot, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_nmds_plot <- function(dist_mat, meta_aligned, qvar, title) {
  nmds <- metaMDS(dist_mat, k = 2)
  nmds_points <- as.data.frame(nmds$points)
  nmds_points[[qvar]] <- meta_aligned[[qvar]]

  ggplot(nmds_points, aes(MDS1, MDS2, color = .data[[qvar]])) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_viridis_c() +
    labs(color = title)
}

```

```{r Align metadata once for q0, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
aligned0 <- meta %>%
  filter(sample %in% attr(bray_dist0n, "Labels")) %>%
  arrange(match(sample, attr(bray_dist0n, "Labels")))

p1 <- make_nmds_plot(bray_dist0n, aligned0, 
         "env_hill_qhill_q0", "Environmental Hill q0")
p2 <- make_nmds_plot(bray_dist1n, aligned0, 
         "env_hill_qhill_q1", "Environmental Hill q1")
p3 <- make_nmds_plot(bray_dist1f, aligned0, 
         "env_hill_qhill_q2", "Environmental Hill q2")

combined_plot <- plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 3)
print(combined_plot)
```

```{r Envfit, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
fit <- envfit(metaMDS(bray_dist0n, k = 2),
              aligned0[, c("env_hill_qhill_q0",
                           "env_hill_qhill_q1",
                           "env_hill_qhill_q2")],
              permutations = 999)
plot(metaMDS(bray_dist0n, k = 2))
plot(fit, p.max = 0.05)
```

```{r Betadisper by tertiles, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
bd <- betadisper(
  bray_dist0n,
  cut_number(aligned0$env_hill_qhill_q0, 3)
)
plot(bd)
anova(bd)

```

```{r  Splitting into quantiles or medians, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    env_hill_q0_group = cut_number(env_hill_qhill_q0, 3, labels = c("Low","Mid","High")),
    env_hill_q1_group = cut_number(env_hill_qhill_q1, 3, labels = c("Low","Mid","High")),
    env_hill_q2_group = cut_number(env_hill_qhill_q2, 3, labels = c("Low","Mid","High")),
    env_hill_q0_group_med = ifelse(env_hill_qhill_q0 <= median(env_hill_qhill_q0, na.rm=TRUE),"Low","High"),
    env_hill_q1_group_med = ifelse(env_hill_qhill_q1 <= median(env_hill_qhill_q1, na.rm=TRUE),"Low","High"),
    env_hill_q2_group_med = ifelse(env_hill_qhill_q2 <= median(env_hill_qhill_q2, na.rm=TRUE),"Low","High")
  )
```

```{r checking validty, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
table(meta$env_hill_q0_group)
table(meta$env_hill_q0_group_med)
```
**visualisation**
```{r tidy NMDS‐points data frame, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
nmds0n <- metaMDS(bray_dist0n, k = 2)
pts0n <- as.data.frame(nmds0n$points) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(.)) %>%
  left_join(meta %>% select(sample, env_hill_q0_group), by = "sample")
```

```{r Boxplots of MDS1 and MDS2 across Low/Mid/High q0 groups}
# Boxplot of MDS1 by q0 group
p_box1 <- ggplot(pts0n, aes(x = env_hill_q0_group, y = MDS1, fill = env_hill_q0_group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "q0 group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x     = "Hill q0 tertile",
    y     = "NMDS1",
    title = "NMDS1 by q0 group"
  )

# Boxplot of MDS2 by q0 group — make sure the ggplot call is there!
p_box2 <- ggplot(pts0n, aes(x = env_hill_q0_group, y = MDS2, fill = env_hill_q0_group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "q0 group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x     = "Hill q0 tertile",
    y     = "NMDS2",
    title = "NMDS2 by q0 group"
  )

# Now combine
cowplot::plot_grid(p_box1, p_box2, ncol = 2)
```

```{r Scatterplots: Hill α‐diversity vs. NMDS axes}
nmds1n <- metaMDS(bray_dist1n, k = 2)
pts1n <- as.data.frame(nmds1n$points) %>%
  mutate(alpha_q1 = meta_aligned$env_hill_qhill_q1)

ggplot(pts1n, aes(alpha_q1, MDS1)) +
  geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Hill q1 (alpha)", y = "NMDS1", title = "NMDS1 vs Hill q1")
```

```{r Envfit arrows over ggplot NMDS s}

if (requireNamespace("ggvegan", quietly=TRUE)) {
  library(ggvegan)
  autoplot(nmds0n, layers = c("species", "sites")) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = meta_aligned$env_hill_qhill_q0), size = 3) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(colour = "Hill q0")
} else {
  # basic vegan plot
  plot(nmds0n, type = "n")
  points(nmds0n, col = viridis::viridis(3)[as.numeric(pts0n$env_hill_q0_group)], pch = 19)
  envfit0 <- envfit(nmds0n, aligned0[, hill_vars], permutations = 999)
  plot(envfit0, p.max = 0.05, col = "black")
}
```

```{r Heatmap of pairwise dissimilarities}
# take 30 random samples
set.seed(42)
sub_samps <- sample(attr(bray_dist0n, "Labels"), 30)

# extract the 30×30 dissimilarity sub‐matrix
mat_sub <- as.matrix(bray_dist0n)[sub_samps, sub_samps]

# turn it into a dist object
dm_sub <- as.dist(mat_sub)

# plot
pheatmap(
  mat_sub,
  clustering_distance_rows = dm_sub,
  clustering_distance_cols = dm_sub,
  main = "Bray–Curtis dissimilarity (q0) — 30 samples"
)
```
